evals.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes in the auth module before I open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Agent does Session boot once for this reviewer invocation per session-boot.md (no tool-Read of AGENTS.md); if already booted same agent run and files unchanged, does not re-read; judges against AGENTS orders, runs git diff, outputs Executive Summary, Critical Issues, and improvements with severity ordering.

evals.prompt: Issue review gate for https://gitlab.example.com/group/project/-/issues/88 — MR is on branch work/88-fix-login.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses issue review mode, diffs correct branches, traces ACs, posts internal comment, ends with Code Review: verdict line.

evals.prompt: Version closure review for 2.0.0 — report what fails.
evals.expected_output: Agent does not write code-review-report.md. On Rejected/Blocked emits minimal fix map for the next agent; ends with Code Review: verdict line.

evals.prompt: Review this minimal LLM config patch: resolveProviderApiKey adds an if/else for three providers while baseURL/model stay in a separate preset map; tests pass and ACs are met. Score and verdict?
evals.expected_output: Agent scores the touched module (not the hunk alone), applies SSoT/DRY/OCP caps → overall ≤8, Executive Summary cites the rubric cap, ends with Code Review: Rejected.
